name: What is the process for surface restoration with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for surface restoration with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our surface restoration process typically begins with an on-site assessment to evaluate the condition of your surfaces and discuss your needs. We then prepare a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Once approved, our team cleans and prepares the surface, performs necessary repairs, applies sealants or coatings, and finishes with a thorough inspection. We keep you informed throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessment, proposal, surface preparation, repair, application of sealants, and final inspection.
